p: of violence: The Prophet complains to God, and bewails that among the Jews is left no fairness and brotherly love: but instead of these reigns cruelty, theft, contention, and strife.
surround the righteous: To suppress him, if any should show himself zealous of God's cause.
perverted: Because the judges who should remedy this excess, are as evil as the rest.
ye will not believe: As in times past you would not believe God's word, so you will not now believe the strange plagues which are at hand.
their judgment and their dignity shall: They themselves will be your judges in this cause, and none will have authority over them to control them.
east wind: For the Jews most feared this wind, because it destroyed their fruits.
as the sand: They will be so many in number.
dust: They will cast up mounds against it.

pass over: The Prophet comforts the faithful that God will also destroy the Babylonians, because they will abuse this victory, and become proud and insolent, attributing the praise of this to their idols.
die: He assures the godly of God's protection, showing that the enemy can do no more than God has appointed, and also that their sins require such a sharp rod.
fishes of the sea: So that the great devours the small, and the Chaldeans destroy all the world.
net: Meaning that the enemies flatter themselves, and glory in their own strength, power, and intellect.
the nations: Meaning, that they would not.
